verdict.line: You lose if you melee-trade into Feint's shield or walk into Shadow Dash's taunt range; you win by poking with Seismic Shard, stacking armor, and saving Unstoppable Force for fights outside the lane.

brief.thesis: Shen's Feint (W) shield and Shadow Dash (E) taunt let him dictate every early trade, while Vorpal Blade (Q) heals him through your poke — which is why this matchup sits at 44.9% over 1648 games with both the lane and solo-kill edge going to Shen. Malphite has no reliable way to punish Shen 1v1 before level 6, and even after that Unstoppable Force (R) is on too long a cooldown to flip a straight duel, so the lane is won by scaling armor and using Malphite as a gank/teamfight piece rather than a laner who kills Shen outright.

theirWindow.when: Shadow Dash (E) off cooldown, in range
theirWindow.what: Shen's Shadow Dash taunts any champion it passes through on the way to its target. Never stand in his 575-range dash lane or extend past minions when it's up — walking into it means eating free follow-up damage with no way to respond.

yourWindow.when: Feint (W) just used or on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Feint absorbs incoming damage for a few seconds, so trading into it wastes your Q. Wait for him to burn it (cooldown 9/8/7/6/5s) and then land Seismic Shard (Q, 625 range, 8s cooldown) plus an auto while it's down.

start.item: Doran's Ring > Health Potion > Health Potion
start.why: The most-picked start (68.5% pick) — mana and AP let you spam Seismic Shard for poke damage without running dry, while the potions offset Vorpal Blade chip.

boots.why: Shen's damage leans on autos (Ki Strike) and Vorpal Blade — the flat auto-attack reduction cuts the exact damage he uses to punish a taunted trade.

core.why: Early armor and burn damage let you hold waves and poke back passively while you're behind in the lane.
Adds armor against Shen's physical half and punishes him for sticking to autos to proc Ki Strike.
More armor to scale your Ground Slam (E) damage, plus the attack speed slow further dulls Shen's auto-reset trading.

you are ahead and want more Unstoppable Force uptime for fights

runes.keystoneWhy: The higher-winrate page for this matchup (46% over the Comet page's 43.5%) — the extra max health and sustain-per-hit help you survive forced taunt trades instead of trying to out-poke a shield.

summoners.why: The dominant pick (77.8% of games) — this is a scaling, defensive lane, so Teleport lets you reset off a backed wave rather than walking, while Flash dodges Shadow Dash's taunt or buys time against his teleport-in R.

playing.title: Poke with Q, don't melee trade
playing.detail: Lead with Seismic Shard (Q, 625 range, 8s cooldown) instead of meleeing — Shen's autos trigger Ki Strike bonus damage and his Feint (W) can absorb your short-cooldown trades for free.

playing.title: Track Shadow Dash cooldown
playing.detail: Shen's Shadow Dash (E, 575 range, cooldown 16/14/12/10/8s) taunts any champion it passes through. Never walk into dash range or extend past minions while it's up.

playing.title: Burst only after Feint drops
playing.detail: Feint (W, cooldown 9/8/7/6/5s) absorbs incoming damage for a few seconds. Bait it out on a minion or wait for him to use it, then land your Q and autos in the window it's down.

playing.title: Don't force all-ins
playing.detail: Vorpal Blade (Shen's Q) heals allies who attack the target and shortens his Ki Strike cooldown, so extended trades favor him. Play for poke and farm instead of forcing a kill.

playing.title: Save R for ganks, not duels
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force (R, 1000 range, cooldown 130/115/100/80/80s) recharges too slowly to win a straight 1v1. Use it to join mid or jungle fights where the knock-up changes a teamfight.

playing.title: Build armor to scale E
playing.detail: Ground Slam (E) deals magic damage based on your Armor, so Sunfire Aegis into Thornmail into Frozen Heart both tanks Shen's mixed damage and raises your own poke and attack-speed shred.

playing.title: Respect his global R
playing.detail: Stand United (R, cooldown 200/180/160/160/160s) shields and teleports Shen to an ally anywhere on the map. If he vanishes from lane post-6, assume he's answering a play and push your side instead.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, boots, runes, summoner spells, and win rates above are pulled from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the tactical reasoning — taunt timing, trade windows, and the scaling plan — is my own read of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Do not get taunted by Shen in lane. Try to attack him with [Q] when he does not have his shield.
